__meta.note: Content reference tables. Data only - no behaviour depends on this file being present.
__meta.source: community data dump (trim.data-dump), cross-checked against the installed bundle

elements.name: Auralite
elements.description: A crystalline shard that hardens into Auralite Crystal when activated.

elements.name: Aurixite
elements.description: A crystalline mass created by transmuting Florinol.

elements.name: Caulk
elements.description: A quick-setting compound that solidifies on impact.

elements.name: Cloud
elements.description: A slowly drifting condensation of steam that eventually falls as rain.

elements.name: Coolant
elements.description: A nuclear cooling liquid used in reactor systems.

elements.name: Dry Amethelis
elements.description: A lighter, dried version of Amethelis that burns into Florin.

elements.name: Florin
elements.description: A gas created by burning dry petals.

elements.name: Florinol
elements.description: A liquid that stores energy and can be transmuted into Aurixite.

elements.name: Growing Void Seed
elements.description: A void seed that has been planted and is growing into a void flower.

elements.name: Heated Water
elements.description: Water that has been heated. Heat disperses to neighbors over time.

elements.name: Irradiated Crystal
elements.description: A crystalline solid formed when coolant is exposed to reactor core radiation.

elements.name: Liquid Copper
elements.description: A molten copper liquid created by smelting Copper.

elements.name: Liquid Gold
elements.description: A precious liquid metal created by smelting Gold.

elements.name: Moonhop
elements.description: A bouncy lunar element.

elements.name: Oil
elements.description: A flammable liquid that can be used to create fuel.

elements.name: Prismaline
elements.description: Spectral gas distilled from Prismite.

elements.name: Prismite
elements.description: A prismatic slush condensed from each mined Aura crystal.

elements.name: Pyronol
elements.description: A luminous liquid produced by smelting Aurixite.

elements.name: Sunsand
elements.description: Desert sand that hardens when it comes to rest.

elements.name: Voidhusk
elements.description: Drained cosmic residue.

elements.name: Voidjuice
elements.description: A mysterious cosmic liquid created from the fusion of Void Petal and Moonhop.

elements.name: Void Petal
elements.description: A mysterious petal from a void flower that contains cosmic energy.

elements.name: Void Seed
elements.description: Mysterious seeds from the void that contain the essence of outer space.

structures.name: Synthesizer
structures.description: Converts matters by transmuting one resource into another. This allows transformations such as Florinol into Aurixite.

structures.name: Burner Belt
structures.description: Moves elements at regular belt speed. Ignites flammable materials above when fueled by an adjacent Thermal Buffer. Without heat, acts as a normal belt.

structures.name: Clearing Frame
structures.description: Moves elements inside.

structures.name: Collector
structures.description: A collector tile that you can put Gold in, giving you {creditsSymbol}.

structures.name: Conveyor Belt
structures.description: Transports Sand and other solid elements. Hold {key.ReverseBuildDirection} to reverse direction when building.

structures.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.2
structures.description: Moves elements faster.

structures.name: Copper Mold
structures.description: A mold that only accepts Liquid Copper. When filled, it transforms into a solid Power Brick that can be used to store Energy.

structures.name: Critter Fence
structures.description: A barrier that lets every element pass through but keeps critters from crossing.

structures.name: Earth Stratacore
structures.description: Slowly generates and reinforces Earth Strataform. Only one can be placed at a time.

structures.name: Energy Connector
structures.description: A passive conductor that bridges power structures so Energy can flow between them. For example, connecting a Steam Turbine to a Power Brick network.

structures.name: Harmonizer
structures.description: Consumes two materials and converts them into one.

structures.name: Filter
structures.description: Filters out elements based on the filter settings. The filtered element goes through while the rest will get transported as usual.

structures.name: Advanced Filter
structures.description: Filters multiple element types at once, including liquids and gases.

structures.name: Filter Wall
structures.description: Filters elements based on filter settings without acting as a conveyor.

structures.name: Advanced Filter Wall
structures.description: Filters multiple element types at once, including liquids and gases, without acting as a conveyor.

structures.name: Foundation
structures.description: A basic block foundation. Hold {key.ReverseBuildDirection} to reverse the direction of angled blocks.

structures.name: Glass Foundation
structures.description: A transparent glass foundation.

structures.name: Flux Emanator
structures.description: Converts Voidbloom into Fluxite.

structures.name: Florinol Battery
structures.description: Putting Florinol in a battery generates and stores Energy.

structures.name: Planter Box
structures.description: Drop Wet Seed on a Planter Box to start growing flowers that you can destroy to get Gold and Amethelis.

structures.name: Pyro Dispenser
structures.description: Fires a flame burst every {seconds} seconds in the direction it was placed. Each shot consumes heat from an adjacent Thermal Buffer.

structures.name: Aerokinetic Fan
structures.description: Blows petals and powders through the air, such as Amethelis and Snow.

structures.name: Launcher
structures.description: Will launch elements upward (straight or to the sides). You can build a column of launchers to create a vertical conveyor lift.

structures.name: Launcher Mk.2
structures.description: Launches elements faster.

structures.name: Wall Light
structures.description: A static light that illuminates the area.

structures.name: Liquid Vent
structures.description: Releases liquids from the connected pipe.

structures.name: Pipe
structures.description: Pipes are used to transport liquids. Can only be removed while pipes are selected.

structures.name: Power Brick
structures.description: A solid block that stores and distributes energy. Can hold up to {capacity} {ui|resources|energy}.

structures.name: Prismaline Well
structures.description: Drains the Prismaline buffer and emits Prismaline above at a fixed rate. Must be built just outside the disk of the Aura Extractor.

structures.name: Prismite Well
structures.description: Drains the Prismite buffer and emits Prismite below at a fixed rate. Must be built just outside the disk of the Aura Extractor.

structures.name: Pump
structures.description: Draws in liquid and runs it through the connected pipes.

structures.name: Conveyor Portal
structures.description: A linked pair of short-range portals used to move elements across gaps or over other conveyor belt lines.

structures.name: Retro Console
structures.description: A playable gaming console. Place it and use Game Controller to play by hovering the console and pressing the arrow keys.

structures.name: Shaker
structures.description: Place Wet Sand on the shaker to refine it automatically into Gold (↓) and Residue. Should be built diagonally to allow natural throughput.

structures.name: AND Gate
structures.description: Outputs On only if all inputs are On.

structures.name: Buffer
structures.description: Forwards its input unchanged.

structures.name: Signal Button
structures.description: Press to pulse a linked signal.

structures.name: Door
structures.description: Door that can be toggled by pressing or via sensor signals.

structures.name: Signal Lamp
structures.description: Indicator that lights up when its linked signal is On.

structures.name: NAND Gate
structures.description: Outputs On unless all inputs are On.

structures.name: NOR Gate
structures.description: Outputs On only if all inputs are Off.

structures.name: NOT Gate
structures.description: Outputs the inverse of a single input (requires exactly 1 input).

structures.name: OR Gate
structures.description: Outputs On if any input is On.

structures.name: Presence Sensor
structures.description: Emits a signal while at least one element is inside its 4x4 area.

structures.name: Pulse Sensor
structures.description: Emits a short On pulse when its 4x4 area becomes full.

structures.name: Repeater
structures.description: Delays signal by one tick.

structures.name: Signal Sensor
structures.description: Emits a signal when its 4x4 area is full of elements.

structures.name: Signal Switch
structures.description: Press to toggle a linked signal.

structures.name: Toggle (T-FlipFlop)
structures.description: Memory bit. Toggles On/Off on each input pulse (rising edge).

structures.name: XNOR Gate
structures.description: Outputs On if an even number of inputs are On.

structures.name: XOR Gate
structures.description: Outputs On if an odd number of inputs are On.

structures.name: Smelter
structures.description: Periodically smelts resources placed on top into liquid form. Uses heat from an adjacent Thermal Buffer or Lava.

structures.name: Snowmaker
structures.description: Consumes Water above and {amount} Energy to spawn Snow below.

structures.name: Steam Turbine
structures.description: Generates energy when Steam passes through the turbine.

structures.name: Aura Extractor
structures.description: Creates the Aura Extractor. Press the placed structure to command the swarm.

structures.name: Thermal Buffer
structures.description: Stores and exchanges heat. Charge it with the Flamethrower, or let it consume adjacent Lava / Snow. Connected buffers equalize temperature.

structures.name: Steam Dryer
structures.description: Converts Amethelis into Dry Amethelis when put on top, using Steam below as fuel.

structures.name: Condenser
structures.description: Condenses adjacent gases into their liquid forms (e.g. Florin into Florinol). Uses cold from an adjacent Thermal Buffer or Snow above.

structures.name: Kinetic Press
structures.description: Drop Burnt Residue on the Kinetic Press from a great height to refine it into Gold and Seed.

structures.name: Void Rift
structures.description: Opens a mysterious rift that produces Void Seed from the depths of space.

items.name: Blinker
items.description: Teleports you to where you click.

items.name: Caulk Blaster
items.description: Shoots a stream of Caulk that solidifies on impact.

items.name: Select & Move
items.description: A marquee tool that can be used to move or copy structures.

items.name: Corraller
items.description: Projects an energy field that captures creatures and pulls them in.

items.name: Cryoblaster
items.description: Creates Snow that can freeze Water and solidify Lava.

items.name: Delete
items.description: A demolition tool that can be used to remove structures.

items.name: Digger Drone
items.description: A drone that digs autonomously until hitting a hard surface.

items.name: Drill
items.description: Drills through hard materials.

items.name: Energy Siphon
items.description: Hold on a power line or brick: each tick moves 1 energy from stores outside that network into it.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.description: Burns Residue, melts Ice and vaporizes Water into Steam that rises and becomes rain.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.description: Shoots a flare that lights up the area.

items.name: Flashlight
items.description: Hold to shine a light where you aim.

items.name: Grabber
items.description: A grabber that can be used to pick up materials.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.description: Helps you move around.

items.name: Gun
items.description: A long-distance mining tool. Strictly for digging, not killing.

items.name: Hauler Drone
items.description: Deploys hauler drones that will automatically transport materials.

items.name: Void Gun
items.description: Uses Voidjuice to excavate the ground.

items.name: Laser
items.description: Lasers through hard materials.

items.name: Locator
items.description: Uses Voidjuice to scan for the nearest artifact and pulse a directional ring toward it.

items.name: Wall Tool
items.description: Use to add and remove walls.

items.name: Precision Laser
items.description: A laser for shaping Caulk and Solidite.

items.name: Prefabulator
items.description: Use to copy terrain and place as structure.

items.name: Recall Shard
items.description: Places a recall portal. Using the shard again teleports back to it, consuming Voidbloom stacked directly above the recall portal's base.

items.name: Recon Drone
items.description: Deploys a fast scout drone. Left Click to take/release control, Right Click to recall.

items.name: Game Controller
items.description: Hover a placed Retro Console and press arrows to play. Change game above the hotbar.

items.name: Rocket Launcher
items.description: A rocket launcher. For digging big holes.

items.name: Shotgun
items.description: Shoots slugs to make holes.

items.name: Shovel
items.description: Dig a hole.

items.name: Signal Linker
items.description: Press senders/receivers and drag to wire signals.

items.name: Sweeper Drone
items.description: Launches a swarm of drones to sweep materials from the ground.

items.name: Teleporter
items.description: A teleporter that can be used to get around.

items.name: Propulsion Trowel
items.description: Destroys everything.

items.name: Vacuum
items.description: Collects piles of elements in tanks that can be unloaded.

items.name: Volcanizer
items.description: Creates Lava.
